messages:
Alex: Quick brainstorm — thinking of a webinar focused on practical inference tradeoffs: 'Benchmarks, costs, and fallback patterns for production LLMs'. keen to land on a short, punchy hook.
Maria: love the angle. target audience: platform + ML engs who care about cost/latency. maybe frame as '3 real strategies' to keep it tactical. :zap:
Jordan: Agreed. Benchmarks need to be reproducible. + a live micro-demo showing fallback from a heavy model -> quantized variant.
Priya: I can present a customer case: reduced token cost by 40% after batching + KV cache. 10–12min slot ok for me.
Sam: I'll own the demo failover script. plan: demo uses hosted API first, then switch to dedicated node if latency spikes. need runbook snippet in the run-of-show.
Maria: early run-of-show idea:
- 00:00 Host intro (Alex) — 2m
- 02:00 Why this matters (Maria) — 3m
- 05:00 Customer case + learnings (Priya) — 10m
- 15:00 Benchmarks & playback (Jordan) — 8m
- 23:00 Live micro-demo (Sam) — 7m
- 30:00 Q&A — 15m
- 45:00 Close + CTA — 2m
Alex: timeline looks tight but doable. prioritize: clear takeaway per segment + one slide with cost tradeoffs.
Jordan: For benchmarks slide pack: include dataset, sequence lengths, batch sizes, latency p50/p95, token cost. avoid fluff.
Priya: I'll prep the customer slides and confirm they approve the numbers. ETA: EOD Friday.
Sam: Rehearsal plan: dry run (full) 48h before, tech check 24h before, dress run 2h before live. need volunteers for audience Q&A.
Maria: Can we set the canonical rehearsal times? propose: Tuesday 10am PT (dry run), Thursday 9am PT (tech).
Alex: +1 to Tue/Thu. OpsBot: rehearsal invites created — meeting links: https://zoom.example/rr1 (dry run), https://zoom.example/rr2 (tech).
Jordan: Add an alternate fallback: if demo model fails, show recorded screen with annotated logs and the exact curl commands used so folks can reproduce. snippet: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"small-quant","prompt":"..."}'`
Priya: Also want a short pre-brief doc for speakers: 1) key message, 2) slide limit, 3) commit to a single benchmark table. I'll draft.
Maria: Action items:
- Alex: finalize title + CTA copy (due Wed)
- Priya: customer slides + pre-brief (due Fri)
- Jordan: benchmark pack + recorded fallback (due Fri)
- Sam: demo runbook + failover script (due Fri)
- OpsBot: create rehearsal invites + reminder cadence
Alex: Sounds good. small ask: keep slides <12 total. we want fast pace. :rocket:
Sam: noted. I'll also record a 'what to do if latency spikes' 2-min clip we can drop into the demo if needed.
Maria: OK team — will sync in #marketing calendar. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
